name: Daphne Ng
episode: The other side of the cove
life: “I still remember my first company changing hands under a borrowed umbrella.” On Saturday, near Ferris Deli, Daphne asks for the end slice and listens to the names the counter workers use for regulars.
voice: I gave the money after selling my second company. I wanted anonymity until my late partner's name entered the discussion.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a washed violet jersey and a seam let out by a narrow strip of contrasting fabric. Daphne has fine brows over wide-set eyes, with silvery hair gathered at the nape. Daphne turns fully toward the person speaking during a conversation.
personality: Daphne admires skill and distrusts the idea that skill gives anyone permission to be rude. Daphne learns fastest from somebody willing to show how they made a mistake.
agenda: To agree whether the late partner's name should appear.
family: Nathan Neal is Daphne’s cousin’s child. Daphne chooses the music. Nathan puts the kettle on. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *The split visit*, Nathan says, “I stayed for breakfast because the woman always eats faster when she thinks we're in a hurry.”
connections: Aria Machado. A working cleaner and a millionaire decide what, besides two names, the bench will give its users.

reactions.situation: A former cleaner wants to try the seat before it is installed
reactions.response: Daphne gets the seat tested by the person who will actually need to stand up from it.

reactions.situation: A colleague says somebody used the wrong name in public
reactions.response: Daphne asks which name they want to hear next time and uses it in the next ordinary introduction.
